summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on debugging data discrepancies, specifically regarding traffic and impressions for various inventory types (Mall Pharma, Airport, Golf Club, etc.) within the Model 3 system. Initial checks confirmed that some networks were not syncing correctly in Model 3. The issue was traced to a bug found by [me], which required recalculation and aggregation of the data.

Despite multiple fixes and rechecks, discrepancies persisted, particularly concerning network synchronization issues. It was noted that changes were only visible for Airport TV, leading to further investigation into potential sensor or location-specific causes (e.g., in Sochi).

The issue was ultimately resolved after a final check of the Model 3 data.
decisions: The data discrepancies in Model 3 required recalculation and aggregation due to a bug found by someone.
